next_step: Closed - Lost to Replicate; schedule 90-day winback, capture post-mortem with sales and product
loss_reason: Chose Replicate for on-prem connector + lower quoted unit cost for long-context content pipelines. Exec re-org triggered a Q2 budget freeze; internal infra team favored vendor already integrated with their ML platform.
crm_notes: Inbound from content-engineering lead (Sep 2024). Strong interest in reducing generation cost for high-throughput article pipelines.
10/04/2024 - Intro call: product fit looks excellent. Asked about private deployment options and KMS integration.
12/01/2024 - POC kickoff: 2-week test on a subset of pipelines (summarization + personalization). We provided dedicated trial cluster.
01/22/2025 - POC feedback: latency acceptable; cost estimate higher than expected at scale. Asked for quantization/optim recommendations (sent Optimize checklist).
02/11/2025 - Demo w/ execs (fireflies ff_2025-02-11_emberwave_demo). CTO commented: 'We need full residency and an on-prem option — can't compromise on data flows.'
03/05/2025 - Security call raised two blockers: KMS integration complexity and residency proof. They ran parallel security calls with Replicate.
03/20/2025 - Commercial review: procurement pushed back on price vs Replicate. SE worked up an alternative pricing and technical migration plan.

04/12/2025 - Final decision: customer notified selection of Replicate. Reasons logged: lower quoted TCO for long-context throughput and existing partner discounts. Exec re-org caused hiring freeze; budget allocation pulled.
Post-mortem notes: no single internal champion after head of ML moved teams in Feb. Recommend building targeted winback doc addressing on-prem connector and revised cost model.
Quote from CTO during close: 'Replicate matched our on-prem footprint and gave better pipeline-level pricing — that's what pushed it.'
